scope: Three existing unreviewed authored IDEA proposals; no readiness or experiment authorization.

candidates.title: A whole-word candidate binds one botanical part class
candidates.prediction: A candidate whole associates with one independently indexed root/leaf/seed/flower class across held folios after section/page controls; unrelated parts remain near baseline.
candidates.countermodel: A generic material or register marker gives diffuse part associations and no held-folio concentration.
candidates.independent_evidence_available: Partial: admitted botanical selectors and prior botanical-part source work exist in experiments/yolo/gdt809_repaired_joint_reading_registration/REPORT.md and related held botanical reports; these do not yet constitute an independent gold part index.
candidates.missing_input: Frozen external part index with held folio assignments and alternate-reading policy.
candidates.smallest_next_source_check: Audit the exact GDT809 part assignments and mark which are independently source-named versus analyst defaults before any association score.

candidates.title: Record genre changes field-role distribution
candidates.prediction: The same whole has a reproducible role interaction between independently classified description and instruction records beyond register and position; a portable meaning predicts no interaction.
candidates.countermodel: Existing record-size, section, or position differences explain apparent role changes without genre semantics.
candidates.independent_evidence_available: Partial: GDT273_Q13_FIELD_SEQUENCE_GRAMMAR_REPORT.md provides record/field inventories and held comparisons, but its labels are structural and do not independently establish whole-level semantic roles.
candidates.missing_input: Blind, source-bound description/instruction genre labels and a whole-level role rubric held out from candidate selection.
candidates.smallest_next_source_check: Audit GDT273's exact record classifications and identify a fixed subset whose genre labels are source-attested rather than parser-derived.

candidates.title: A causal connector predicts a dependent downstream state
candidates.prediction: Candidate-bearing links are followed by state consequences conditional on the preceding event more often than matched sequential pairs; a simple list model predicts no dependency interaction.
candidates.countermodel: Record position and ordinary action-to-state ordering create the apparent dependency without a causal operator.
candidates.independent_evidence_available: Structural event fields and transition reports exist, including experiments/yolo/gdt344_grammar_transition_paths/REPORT.md, but no independent causal annotation or gold consequence relation is available.
candidates.missing_input: Predeclared causal-versus-sequential annotation from an independent source model, with held records.
candidates.smallest_next_source_check: Inspect the GDT344 transition definitions and separate source-attested event relations from analyst-imposed causal language before selecting candidate occurrences.

not_selected: Other raw proposals either lack a more direct semantic countermodel, overlap already screened owner/antecedent/degree/role/quantity/genre mechanisms, or require an independent endpoint that is currently less concrete.
route_checks: Exact prediction route-checks were run for all three candidate designs. Lexical navigation and prior reports are treated as pointers, not semantic gold.
